concept.title: Three Diwali looks, one mirror
concept.hook: Don't want to spend a bomb on Diwali, I have got you covered
concept.voiceoverScript: Don't want to spend a bomb on Diwali? I have got you covered. Pehla look, yeh co-ord, slub cotton hai, bilkul soft aur breathable. Doosra look, ek twirl, aur dekho kaise flow karta hai. Diwali photos ke liye bilkul ready. Aur last, maroon anarkali. Tiers, thread work, dupatte pe embroidery, aur pure cotton, toh poora din comfortable.

scenes.visualPrompt: Cosy bedroom corner beside a tall full-length mirror, strings of warm fairy lights and small lit clay diyas on a wooden side table, marigold garland draped on the mirror frame, early evening golden-hour light mixed with warm lamp glow, medium full-body shot at eye level, static camera. She wears a fully stitched full-sleeve co-ord set of top and pant in soft textured slub cotton with a relaxed regular fit, colour and print as shown in the reference. She steps into frame smiling, turns side-on to show the full sleeves, then runs her fingers over the slub cotton texture of the sleeve while talking to camera. Warm, festive, friendly mood. No text or signage anywhere.
scenes.dialogue: Don't want to spend a bomb on Diwali? I have got you covered. Pehla look, yeh co-ord, slub cotton hai, bilkul soft aur breathable.

She now wears the second festive ethnic outfit exactly as shown in the reference images. She does a slow full twirl so the garment swings and settles, then faces camera and gestures down at the outfit while talking. Warm, festive, friendly mood. No text or signage anywhere.
scenes.dialogue: Doosra look, ek twirl, aur dekho kaise flow karta hai. Diwali photos ke liye bilkul ready.

scenes.visualPrompt: Same cosy bedroom corner beside the tall full-length mirror, same strings of warm fairy lights and small lit clay diyas on the wooden side table, same marigold garland on the mirror frame, same early evening golden-hour light mixed with warm lamp glow, same medium full-body eye-level framing, static camera. She now wears a maroon sleeveless round-neck calf-length tiered anarkali kurta in pure cotton with tonal thread-work ethnic motifs, matching solid maroon trousers, and a maroon pure cotton embroidered dupatta over one shoulder. She lifts the dupatta edge toward camera to show the embroidery, then sways so the tiers flare. Warm, festive, friendly mood. No text or signage anywhere.
scenes.dialogue: Aur last, maroon anarkali. Tiers, thread work, dupatte pe embroidery, aur pure cotton, toh poora din comfortable.

concept.caption: Three Diwali looks, one mirror 🪔 Look 1: Kohinoor Kashmiri co-ord by Titli India, soft slub cotton and full sleeves. Look 2: from Nykaa Fashion. Look 3: Vastranikhar maroon tiered anarkali with thread work and an embroidered dupatta. Which one are you wearing this Diwali?
concept.musicMood: Warm, soft festive instrumental with light dhol and sitar, upbeat but gentle

flow.characterPrompt:
CHARACTER REFERENCE (use the attached image as the exact likeness):
A young Indian woman in her mid-twenties with long dark brown hair, loosely waved and falling past her shoulders, parted slightly off-centre. Warm medium skin tone, dark brown almond-shaped eyes, full defined eyebrows, high cheekbones, a softly rounded jaw and a natural warm smile. Slim build, average height.

VOICE: Warm, bright young female voice with a natural Indian English accent, medium pitch, clear unforced pronunciation, conversational rather than presentational. Speaks natural Hinglish, switching easily between Hindi and English. Sounds like a friend talking to camera, not a voice-over. Lively pitch variation, genuine enthusiasm, natural pauses. Never flat, never salesy.
She should always be speaking in hinglish that is mix of english and hindi

This is a fully AI-generated fictional character. No real person, celebrity or
public figure is depicted, referenced or named. Keep her face, hair, skin tone
and marks identical in every shot.
